title: Unfit Mom Gets Caught Drunk and Asleep at the Wheel with Toddler In The Car
description:
On March 16th, 2024. An unfit mother gets caught drunk and asleep behind the wheel with her toddler in the car. An officer was on routine patrol when he observed a vehicle that had been parked at a traffic light for quite some time, when the officer went to investigate, she saw that the mother was clearly intoxicated. When conducting the FST's she started acting like a brat and believed that the officers were wrong and she was not intoxicated.
